# Files exempt from the attribution check, one repo-relative path per line.
#
# Deliberately empty, and it should stay that way.
#
# An entry here exempts the WHOLE file from EVERY needle, permanently: the
# check skips the path before reading a byte of it. On a document that keeps
# being edited, a pasted transcript or an embedded image would go unseen
# forever. The cost is not proportional to the problem it solves.
#
# Policy this file exists to record: a third-party product name is not a
# finding. Naming an editor, an MCP client or a competitor in documentation is
# legitimate, and the check does not look for those names at all, so those
# documents need no exemption. What is forbidden is attribution of the
# assistant used to produce the work, and the metadata containers that carry
# it.
#
# Before adding a path, strip the file instead. If a file genuinely must carry
# a needle, prefer narrowing the check to that path and that needle over
# exempting the whole file.
